## 2. Deep Dives into Core Engineering Projects

### CricSphere — High-Performance Sports Intelligence Platform
- Production URL: https://cricsphere-version1.vercel.app/
- Case Study: https://vaibhavbharathula.tech/projects/cricsphere
- Architectural Highlights:
  - Ingested and normalized 22,000+ historical ball-by-ball cricket match datasets across multiple formats.
  - Built an analytical warehouse query layer using DuckDB for instant sub-millisecond point-in-time statistics.
  - Trained 4 distinct machine learning models (including a Stark-tuned LightGBM classifier) to estimate live second-innings win probability dynamically using remaining runs, balls, wickets, and batter-bowler matchups.
  - Implemented server-side response caching to handle rate-limited third-party cricket data streams with minimal latency overhead.

### Nexus — Real-Time Collaborative Operating System
- Case Study: https://vaibhavbharathula.tech/projects/nexus
- Technical Architecture:
  - Media Routing: Offloaded WebRTC video and audio streams to Stream global edge SFU nodes, maintaining sub-50ms transmission latencies.
  - Multiplayer Sync: Integrated Liveblocks with Yjs CRDTs (Conflict-free Replicated Data Types) for collaborative document and whiteboard editors, ensuring concurrent edits merge deterministically without data loss.
  - Zero-Trust Storage: Enforced tenant isolation by brokering file upload and download requests through serverless Next.js edge functions using Firebase Admin SDK. Generates short-TTL signed URLs with immediate revocation triggers (~1.1s revocation delay).
  - Dual-Engine Vector Search: Built semantic document search leveraging Google Gemini embedding-001 (768-dim) vectors indexed via Pinecone with in-memory Firestore cosine similarity fallback.

### CampusPulse AI — Incident Intelligence & Correlation Engine
- Case Study: https://vaibhavbharathula.tech/projects/campuspulse-ai
- Context: Built for the IBM SkillsBuild learning plan project submission (Shortlisted for Regional Finale) with an automated 58/58 test suite.
- Technical Architecture:
  - 4-Factor Deterministic Correlation Engine: Correlates raw, unstructured student complaints into cohesive infrastructure incident clusters:
    1. Spatial Proximity: Haversine geodesic distance scoring between campus locations.
    2. Temporal Exponential Decay: Weighting recent grievances higher using half-life decay modeling.
    3. Semantic Similarity: Gemini embeddings with dynamic vector centroid clustering and cosine similarity matrix calculation.
    4. Categorical Affinity: Subsystem classification matching (e.g., electrical, sanitation, lab infrastructure).
  - Dual-Tier Gemini Integration: Tier 1 for low-latency JSON entity extraction and classification; Tier 2 for root-cause synthesis, impact severity classification, emerging surge detection, and administrative action brief generation.
  - SQLite WAL Database: High-throughput local storage supporting concurrent reader-writer operations.

### AetherAI — Localized Environmental Intelligence Platform
- Case Study: https://vaibhavbharathula.tech/projects/aetherai
- Technical Architecture:
  - Built an asynchronous ML inference API with Python and FastAPI.
  - Trained an XGBoost regression model achieving 94.2% test confidence for multi-pollutant AQI forecasting.
  - Integrated Google Gemini 1.5 Flash to synthesize raw numerical forecasts into personalized health advice based on demographic sensitivities (asthma, outdoor athletic activity).

### BrandRecognizer — Computer Vision Vehicle Classifier
- Case Study: https://vaibhavbharathula.tech/projects/brandrecognizer
- Technical Architecture:
  - Transfer learning architecture utilizing EfficientNetB0 pre-trained on ImageNet.
  - Trained on 11,000+ car images across 50 distinct vehicle brands.
  - Reached ~80% top-1 validation accuracy utilizing aggressive data augmentation (random rotation, zoom, shear, and contrast adjustments) to prevent overfitting.
